style_authority.note: States a 'calm utility style' operations-sheet read and says the settle must not delay further input, but product-context reasoning is terser than a full component/motion-policy check.

reference_selection.note: Applies spring handoff, projection with velocity bounds, soft-boundary mapping and validation checks, but references are not named or justified; selection is only implicit.

anti_generic_redesign.note: 'Should this animate?' gives a conditional yes and removes whole-sheet scaling, decorative bounce and blanket transition: all, though the 'do not animate' reasoning is compact.

evidence_level.note: Labels 'L0 static evidence' and notes runtime unknowns per finding (e.g. 'Computed transitions and frame cost are unknown'), but the evidence labeling is brief.

verified_boundary.note: Verified/Unverified section separates snippet facts from lag, smoothness, frame cost and global accessibility; focus and interruption are covered indirectly via V2/V3 rather than named as unverified.

design_moves.note: M1-M8 include handle feedback, 1:1 transform tracking with pointer capture, presentation interruption, velocity handoff in CSS px/s, bounded projection candidate, r(o)=L*o/(L+|o|) boundaries, and a Reduced Motion commit path. No hysteresis.

scope_control.note: 58 lines, five blockers, eight moves, all motion- and validation-focused with crisp V1-V4 checks.
